props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: The height of the content when collapsed.

props.name: collapsedWidth
props.description: The width of the content when collapsed.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the collapsible when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the collapsible.

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the collapsible. Useful for composition.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: The callback invoked when the exit animation completes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The callback invoked when the open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the collapsible.
